## 77:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** In-day-of my-distress the-Lord I-sought; my-hand at-night was-stretched-out and-not grew-numb; refused to-be-comforted my-soul.
- **LOGOS:** In the day of my trouble I seek the Lord; in the night my hand is stretched out without wearying; my soul refuses to be comforted.
- **PNEUMA:** When I was in deep trouble, I searched for the Lord. All night long I stretched out my hands in prayer, but nothing could comfort me.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
